content.text: The cause is the expiry check in `_expired`: it uses `>`, so an entry whose age equals the TTL is still treated as live. The test expects an entry to expire at exactly TTL, so the comparison should be `>=`. Every path (`get`, `_purge`, and the live count in `put`) goes through `_expired`, so one change covers them all.
